messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting bring-up experiments for q4b_small (4B int8) on the new cluster. Need a clean prompt set for fidelity/regression checks. Current issues: duplicates in our bank inflate pass rates, and long-tailed prompts blow up latency. Can @label_ops carve a 500-sample golden set stratified by length/intent?

maya: +1. For dedupe we should run fingerprint-v2 then fuzzy-span dedupe. I can run a pass and share IDs.

alex: Here's the dedupe command I ran locally:
```bash
python tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/promptbank/seed.jsonl --method fingerprint_v2 --min_sim 0.88 --out s3://tmp/curation/deduped.jsonl
```

label_ops: we can take 500 but need the label schema; do we want binary pass/fail or graded (0-3)? Also need annotators to tag hallucination/copying.

alex: graded 0-3 w/ reason tags (hallucination, unsafe, irrelevant). Add an "adversarial_probe" flag for intentionally tricky prompts. Deadline EOD Fri.

ron: On the eval side I recommend a micro-benchmark: 100 prompts from the golden set run on fp16 baseline, q4b initial, and q4b calibrated. Capture human pass-rate + automated metrics (BLEU-ish, EM, schema-accuracy). Also log p50/p95 latency and token cost.

maya: will set up the eval harness under /ci/runs/bringup-1768509876. I'll pin short/long splits and annotate prompt-intent buckets.

alex: Any objections to running quant calibration (per-layer scale) before labeling? Might reduce false regressions on edge tokens.

ron: do it but version outputs and seed rng. add model.hash and quant.config to the run metadata.

label_ops: sampling now. Posting manifest when done. :mag:

ci-bot: Deploy succeeded for bringup harness (run id bringup-1768509876) :white_check_mark:

label_ops: posted sample manifest: s3://tmp/curation/bringup-manifest-1768509876.jsonl (500 items). Rolling to labelers now.

maya: got it. added holdout split 80/20 for golden vs validation and flagged 50 adversarial probes.

alex: plan: label by Thu, run baseline eval Fri morning, triage regressions Fri afternoon. If we hit >5% human pass-rate drop vs fp16 we'll trigger quick rollback and a narrower bisect.

ron: add a metric for content-structure regressions (JSON schema bumps). Last time that caught prompt-preserving failures.

alex: good call. Also log sample-level diffs and stack traces for model outputs so we can cluster failures.

label_ops: we'll include free-text reason fields for cluster analysis and attach annotator confidence.

maya: ping if you want a tighter dedupe threshold — 0.88 lets paraphrases slip by. I can rerun at 0.925.

alex: please do a rerun at 0.925 for the short-form bucket. Thanks all — tagging @label_ops @maya @ron. :rocket:
